description: Create an @cherami.to inbox at an address the human or the assignment authorizes.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retry safe: repeating the call with the same key and identical arguments within 24 hours of the first request returns the inbox already created. Use a new key for each intended inbox.

local_part.description: The part before @cherami.to, permanent once created: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting and ending with a letter or digit. Lowercased.

name.description: Optional internal name, visible across the account but not to recipients. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

sender_name.description: Optional display name recipients see on outgoing mail. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

name: create_inbox

created_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.

idempotency_expires_at.description: Until this time, a retry with the same idempotency_key returns this inbox.

title: Create inbox
